tasks.title: Kanban board page
tasks.description: Board view that combines Jira issues, task-master tasks and GitHub PRs, with each card linked to Locus chats.

tasks.title: Set up the Jira CLI for the board
tasks.description: Install the Atlassian CLI (acli), run 'acli jira auth login --web', and set a Jira project key on each Locus project so its issues show on the board.
